Title: All non-restricted users can log in successfully
Preconditions: SauceDemo site is accessible, user has valid credentials
Steps:
1. Navigate to saucedemo.com
2. Enter valid username (standard_user, problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, visual_user)
3. Enter universal password
4. Click Login
Expected Result: User lands on the inventory/products page

Title: A locked-out user is refused login
Preconditions: SauceDemo site is accessible, locked_out_user credentials available
Steps:
1. Navigate to saucedemo.com
2. Enter username locked_out_user
3. Enter universal password
4. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message: Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.

Title: Empty or unknown username is rejected
Steps:
1. Navigate to saucedemo.com
2. Leave username empty OR enter invalid_user
3. Enter universal password
4. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message: Username is required OR Username and password do not match

Title: Empty or wrong password is rejected
Steps:
1. Navigate to saucedemo.com
2. Enter valid username standard_user
3. Leave password empty OR enter wrong_password
4. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message: Password is required OR Username and password do not match

Title: On-screen and PDF receipt totals match the expected price
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Steps:
1. Add Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light to cart
2. Click cart icon
3. Complete checkout with valid info
4. Verify on-screen totals (item: $39.98, tax: $3.20, total: $43.18)
5. Download PDF receipt
6. Verify PDF totals match on-screen values
Expected Result: On-screen and PDF totals match; line items match cart contents

Title: Every product shows a distinct image
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Steps:
1. Navigate to inventory page
2. Collect all product image src attributes
3. Compare for uniqueness
Expected Result: All 6 product images have unique src URLs

Title: problem_user sees the same broken image for every product
Preconditions: User is logged in as problem_user
Steps:
1. Log in as problem_user
2. Navigate to inventory page
3. Collect all product image src attributes
4. Verify all images are identical
Expected Result: All product images share the same broken image URL

Title: Sorting actually reorders the product list
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Steps:
1. Navigate to inventory page
2. Select sort option (Price low to high / Price high to low)
3. Collect product prices in displayed order
4. Verify order matches selected sort
Expected Result: Products are displayed in correct ascending/descending price order

Title: problem_user's price sort is broken
Preconditions: User is logged in as problem_user
Steps:
1. Log in as problem_user
2. Navigate to inventory page
3. Select Price (high to low)
4. Collect product prices
5. Verify order is NOT descending
Expected Result: Product prices are NOT in correct descending order (known bug)

Title: Reset App State clears the cart without refreshing the page
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Steps:
1. Add Sauce Labs Backpack to cart
2. Open hamburger menu
3. Click Reset App State
4. Check cart badge
Expected Result: Cart badge is cleared (no item count displayed)

Title: Logging out blocks access to the inventory page via the browser back button
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Steps:
1. Open hamburger menu
2. Click Logout
3. Press browser Back button
4. Check for error message
Expected Result: Error: You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in.

Title: The backpack product image is visually stable
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
Steps:
1. Navigate to inventory page
2. Capture backpack product image as known-good baseline
3. Compare current image against baseline
4. Calculate pixel diff percentage
Expected Result: Pixel diff is <= 2% (images match within tolerance)

Title: visual_user's backpack image differs from the correct rendering
Preconditions: User can log in as both standard_user and visual_user
Steps:
1. Log in as standard_user and capture backpack image as baseline
2. Log out
3. Log in as visual_user
4. Capture backpack image
5. Compare against baseline
Expected Result: Images do NOT match (pixel diff > 2%) confirming visual_user renders differently
